import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open("nw.py").read())
AA3to1 = {'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','LLP':'K','MSE':'M'}
def parse_chain(path, chain):
    res={}; order=[]
    for line in open(path, errors='ignore'):
        if line[:6] in ("ATOM  ","HETATM") and line[21]==chain:
            rn=line[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3to1 or line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            ri=line[22:27].strip()
            if ri not in res: res[ri]=[rn,{},float(line[60:66])]; order.append(ri)
            res[ri][1][line[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
    return res, order, "".join(AA3to1[res[r][0]] for r in order)
af_res, af_order, af_seq = parse_chain("AF-Q4AC99.pdb","A")
plddt=np.array([af_res[k][2] for k in af_order])
print("ACCSL AlphaFold pLDDT: mean %.1f, median %.1f, frac>90: %.2f, frac<50: %.2f" %
      (plddt.mean(), np.median(plddt), (plddt>90).mean(), (plddt<50).mean()))
key_res={241:'G(phos loop)',242:'C',243:'C',267:'Y (Tyr152eq)',270:'F',326:'I',330:'N (Asn209eq)',
         358:'D (Asp237eq)',361:'Y (Tyr240eq)',394:'S',395:'K (Schiff base)',403:'R (PLP-phos)',529:'C/R529'}
for p,l in key_res.items(): print(f"  pLDDT {af_seq[p-1]}{p} ({l}): {af_res[str(p)][2]:.1f}")
print("  mean pLDDT 520-540: %.1f" % plddt[519:540].mean())
print("  mean pLDDT catalytic core 230-410: %.1f" % plddt[229:410].mean())

# PAE between 529 and active site
pae=json.load(open("AF-Q4AC99-pae.json"))
P=np.array(pae[0]['predicted_aligned_error']) if isinstance(pae,list) else np.array(pae['predicted_aligned_error'])
for p in [395,403,358,267]:
    print(f"  PAE(529,{p}) = {P[528,p-1]:.1f} A ; PAE({p},529) = {P[p-1,528]:.1f} A")

# map ACCSL 204/207/423 back to tomato numbering
t_res,t_order,t_seq = parse_chain("1iax.pdb","A")
pairs=nw_affine(af_seq,t_seq)
m={i+1:t_order[j] for i,j in pairs}
for p in [204,207,423,175,176,272,150]:
    print(f"  ACCSL {af_seq[p-1]}{p} <-> tomato ACS {t_seq[t_order.index(m[p])]}{m[p]}" if p in m else f"  ACCSL {p} -> gap")

# ---- FIGURE ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14,5.6), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.25,1]})
ax=axes[0]
geom=json.load(open("plp_pocket_geometry.json"))
labels=['Lys395 NZ\n- PLP C4A','Arg403\n- PLP phosphate','Ser394 OG\n- PLP phosphate','Asn330 ND2\n- PLP','Asp358 OD2\n- PLP N1','Tyr361 OH\n- PLP']
accsl_v=[geom['accsl_vs_plp']['Lys395 NZ - PLP C4A'], geom['accsl_vs_plp']['Arg403 NH1 - PLP phosphate(min)'],
         geom['accsl_vs_plp']['Ser394 OG - PLP phosphate(min)'], geom['accsl_vs_plp']['Asn330 ND2 - PLP(min)'],
         geom['accsl_vs_plp']['Asp358 OD2 - PLP N1'], 3.44]
tom_v=[geom['tomato_vs_plp']['Lys278 NZ - PLP C4A'], geom['tomato_vs_plp']['Arg286 - PLP phos(min)'],
       geom['tomato_vs_plp']['Ser277 OG - PLP phos(min)'], geom['tomato_vs_plp']['Asn209 ND2 - PLP(min)'],
       geom['tomato_vs_plp']['Asp237 OD2 - PLP N1'], 3.30]
x=np.arange(len(labels)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2, tom_v, w, label='tomato ACC synthase 1IAX (crystal)', color='#4C6EF5')
ax.bar(x+w/2, accsl_v, w, label='human ACCSL model (PLP transplanted)', color='#F08C00')
ax.axhline(3.5, ls='--', c='grey', lw=1)
ax.text(5.4, 3.6, 'H-bond range', color='grey', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('distance (Å)'); ax.set_title('PLP cofactor contacts are preserved in human ACCSL', fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
# distance of residue-529 side chain atoms to the substrate analogue AVG
tom_atoms=['CA','CB','CG','CD','NE','CZ','NH1','NH2']
tom_d=[9.81,8.54,7.86,6.57,5.42,4.14,4.08,3.27]
acc_atoms=['CA','CB','SG']; acc_d=[9.87,8.69,7.83]
ax.plot(range(len(tom_d)), tom_d, 'o-', color='#4C6EF5', label='tomato Arg412 (reaches substrate)')
ax.plot(range(len(acc_d)), acc_d, 's-', color='#C92A2A', label='human ACCSL Cys529 (reference allele)')
for i,a in enumerate(tom_atoms): ax.annotate(a, (i, tom_d[i]), textcoords='offset points', xytext=(4,4), fontsize=7, color='#4C6EF5')
for i,a in enumerate(acc_atoms): ax.annotate(a, (i, acc_d[i]), textcoords='offset points', xytext=(4,-11), fontsize=7, color='#C92A2A')
ax.axhline(4.0, ls='--', c='grey', lw=1); ax.text(0.1,4.15,'salt-bridge range', color='grey', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(tom_atoms))); ax.set_xticklabels(['Cβ-1','Cβ','Cγ','Cδ','Nε','Cζ','Nη1','Nη2'], fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('side-chain atom, from backbone outward')
ax.set_ylabel('distance to substrate analogue AVG (Å)')
ax.set_title('Residue 529 sits exactly where the catalytic\nsubstrate arginine of ACC synthase sits', fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
